meta.method: MLS spelling to canonical code, scoped to a jurisdiction. Normalization (uppercase, strip spaces, hyphens, periods, parentheses and slashes, take the token before any semicolon) already collapses most variants. Aliases cover the rest. The unmapped list records strings that match no current code so they are never force-matched.

jefferson-county:TRRAR.note: MLS spelling. Jefferson County Title 17 establishes TRRA (17.319) and TRRAW (17.320) only. Verified against the chapter 17.3 section list on 2026-07-30.

deschutes-county:MUA.note: DCC 18.32 names the zone MUA. The live feed writes MUA10, which this dataset uses as the canonical code.

deschutes-county:RR.note: DCC Title 18 has one rural residential zone, RR-10 (DCC 18.60). A bare RR in a Deschutes County row is that zone.

deschutes-county.SMIA: Surface Mining Impact Area Combining Zone (DCC 18.56)
deschutes-county.SBMH: Sensitive Bird and Mammal Habitat Combining Zone (DCC 18.90)
